fiveLevels.text-video: A small brass lantern with a round handle and cylindrical glass sits on a wooden table in a quiet repair shop at twilight. Initially unlit, it gradually glows amber. One continuous five-second medium, eye-level, locked-camera shot. Realistic brass and glass, soft blue light from the left window. Only the lantern light changes; lantern and camera remain still. No people, text, logo, dialogue, music or cuts. Landscape 16:9.
fiveLevels.image-video: Use the uploaded image as the start frame. The brass lantern remains still on the table while the inner amber glow gradually increases. Preserve handle, glass shape, scale and placement. Locked camera, one continuous five-second shot. No cuts, additional objects or people, dialogue or music.
fiveLevels.missing-reference: Use the uploaded image as the start frame. The lantern is already softly lit and stays lit. One five-second shot with a locked camera. The repairer watches the lantern; from seconds 1–3 his mouth lifts into a faint smile; from seconds 3–5 he holds the smile and downward gaze. Keep head, torso and both hands in place. No looking at camera, visible breath, white vapor, added action or person. Preserve indigo shirt, apron, table and blue window light. No dialogue, music or cuts.
fiveLevels.composite: Image 1 supplies only the repairer’s face, hair, rolled-sleeve indigo shirt and beige apron. Image 2 supplies the brass lantern and room. Create one realistic cinematic landscape 16:9 eye-level medium: the same repairer behind the wooden table, to the left of the unlit lantern, looking down. Both separated hands clearly rest on the table. Preserve round handle, cylindrical glass and lantern design. Blue light from the left window; preserve window shape and shop layout. No extra person, text or logo. This is a video start image.
fiveLevels.sizes: Use the attached workshop image as the only reference. Preserve the repairer’s face, indigo shirt with rolled sleeves, beige apron, unlit brass lantern, table, left window and blue twilight lighting. Create five equal portrait-shaped photographic panels in one horizontal row without text: extreme wide with the entire room and a small repairer; wide with full body behind the table and room; waist-up medium with both hands and lantern; facial close-up; extreme close-up of one eye and part of the nose. Same moment, expression and eye-level camera; change only shot size. No extra people, text or logos.
fiveLevels.angles: Use the attached workshop image as the only reference. Preserve the repairer’s face, indigo shirt with rolled sleeves, beige apron, unlit brass lantern, table, left window and blue twilight lighting. Make four equal landscape panels in a 2×2 grid. Top left: eye-level, repairer watching the tabletop lantern. Top right: high angle looking down diagonally. Bottom left: low angle looking up, showing the near table edge. Bottom right: over his right shoulder with that shoulder in the right foreground, lantern ahead and window on the left. Do not relocate the table or window to fake the angle. Change only camera position, not action. Thin white dividers, no text or logos.
fiveLevels.relight: Edit the supplied repairer-in-shop image. Change only lighting: warm yellow sunlight through the same left window replaces blue twilight. Preserve face, pose, both hands, indigo shirt, beige apron, unlit lantern, table and all objects. No camera or crop change, text or logo. One realistic landscape 16:9 image for a before/after relighting comparison.
fiveLevels.wardrobe: Edit the attached image, replacing only the indigo shirt with an olive-green rolled-sleeve shirt while retaining the beige apron. Preserve face, hair, expression, pose, both hands, unlit lantern, window, lighting, table and objects. No age, build, camera or crop changes, text or logos. One realistic landscape image for a controlled wardrobe comparison.
fiveLevels.static: Use the uploaded image as the exact start frame. The repairer watches the unlit lantern, hands separated on the table. Preserve face, indigo shirt, beige apron, lantern design and light from the left window. Locked eye-level camera, one continuous five-second shot, only very subtle breathing. The lantern stays unlit. No dialogue, music or cuts.
fiveLevels.dolly-first: Use the uploaded image as the exact start frame. The repairer watches the unlit lantern, hands separated on the table. Preserve face, indigo shirt, beige apron, lantern design and light from the left window. Slow dolly-in: move the camera about 30cm toward the repairer without a lens zoom. Eye-level, one continuous five-second shot, only subtle breathing. The lantern stays unlit. No dialogue, music or cuts.
fiveLevels.dolly-revision: Use the uploaded image as the exact start frame. The camera alone advances very slowly straight along the lens axis, without lateral drift, orbit or pan. One continuous five-second slow dolly-in from a medium, moving about 30cm. The repairer stays upright with head and both hands still; no leaning or head turn. Lantern stays unlit. Preserve table layout, window and blue light. No dialogue, music or cuts.
fiveLevels.endpoints: Connect the unlit-lantern start frame to the lit-lantern end frame. One continuous five-second locked-camera shot. The wick at the bottom of the glass gradually burns amber, adding a subtle warm table reflection. Preserve lantern, handle, glass, window and objects. No people, camera movement, cuts, text, dialogue or music.
fiveLevels.sheet: Use the attached portrait as the sole identity reference. Make a four-panel character sheet on light gray in a 2×2 grid. Top left: frontal facial close-up. Top right: a true 90-degree facial profile, nose pointing left, only one eye visible; not merely rotated shoulders. Bottom left: the entire costume from neck down, intentionally excluding the head, with rolled-sleeve indigo shirt, beige apron, dark trousers and brown shoes. Bottom right: full-body rear view including the head in the same outfit. Preserve face, age, hair and proportions. Even soft light, thin white spacing, realistic imagery, no text or logo.
fiveLevels.acting: Use the uploaded image as the start frame. One five-second locked-camera medium. The repairer looks down at the unlit lantern during the first second, exhales gently, then raises his eyes and smiles faintly during seconds 2–4, holding the expression for the last second. Both hands stay separately on the table without lifting. Preserve face, hair, indigo shirt, apron and blue window light. No lantern change, extra person, dialogue, music or cuts.
fiveLevels.lit-actor: Edit the attached image, preserving the repairer’s downward gaze, pose, both hands, face, indigo shirt and apron. Add only a small amber flame at the wick inside the bottom of the glass and very subtle warm reflections on face, apron and table. Preserve lantern shape, handle and placement. Keep blue twilight at the window, camera unchanged; no smoke, added person or text. Same landscape framing as the input.
fiveLevels.reaction: Use the uploaded image as the start frame. The lantern is already softly lit and stays lit. One five-second shot with a locked camera. The repairer watches the lantern; from seconds 1–3 his mouth lifts into a faint smile; from seconds 3–5 he holds the smile and downward gaze. Keep head, torso and both hands in place. No looking at camera, visible breath, white vapor, added action or person. Preserve indigo shirt, apron, table and blue window light. No dialogue, music or cuts.
fiveLevels.storyboard: Use the repairer-in-shop image for character and setting, and the lit-lantern image for the ending lantern. Create a black-and-white pencil storyboard with four horizontal panels in one row. Panel 1: medium of the repairer watching the unlit lantern with both hands on the table. Panel 2: lantern close-up as a small flame appears. Panel 3: facial close-up with raised eyes and a faint smile. Panel 4: lit lantern on the table, no person in frame. Preserve indigo shirt, apron and left window. This is a composition plan, not actual video output. No text or logo.
fiveLevels.hold: Use the uploaded image as the start frame. The lantern is lit from the beginning. Keep the camera still for five seconds, with only natural slight flame flicker and warm reflections on glass. Do not extinguish and relight it, add smoke, change objects, add people, cuts, dialogue or music.

overview.shots: Use the attached image as the reference for the same adult Vietnamese woman: short black bob, mustard-yellow raincoat, navy trousers and red shoulder bag; an old Vietnamese street with a green wooden door and bicycle. Create a realistic photographic comparison plate, no text, labels or logos. Equal panels with thin white dividers, landscape 3:2 overall. Four panels in a 2×2 grid, read left to right, top row then bottom. Panel 1: extreme wide of the street with a small person. Panel 2: wide full body from head to shoes with door and bicycle. Panel 3: waist-up medium with hands visible. Panel 4: face-and-shoulders close-up. Same identity, coat, bag and soft daylight; change only shot size. Recreate clearly distinct framing rather than simply copying the reference.
overview.lens: Use the attached image as the reference for the same adult Vietnamese woman: short black bob, mustard-yellow raincoat, navy trousers and red shoulder bag; an old Vietnamese street with a green wooden door and bicycle. Create a realistic photographic comparison plate, no text, labels or logos. Equal panels with thin white dividers, landscape 3:2 overall.
